name: Cinnamedrine
summary: Cinnamedrine, also known as N-cinnamylephedrine, is a sympathomimetic drug with similar effects relative to those of ephedrine. It also has some local anesthetic activity. Cinnamedrine was previously used, in combination with analgesics, as an antispasmodic to treat dysmenorrhea in the over-the-counter drug Midol in the 1980s. There is a case series of the drug being abused as a psychostimulant.

pharmacology.text: Cinnamedrine (INN, USAN), also known as N-cinnamylephedrine, is a sympathomimetic drug with similar effects relative to those of ephedrine.

uses.text: Cinnamedrine was previously used, in combination with analgesics, as an antispasmodic to treat dysmenorrhea in the over-the-counter drug Midol in the 1980s.

sideEffects.en: Little detailed information is available. As a relative of ephedrine, it can cause a fast heartbeat, raised blood pressure, restlessness, sleeplessness and anxiety.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它的詳細資料很少。作為麻黃鹼的近親，它可能造成心跳加快、血壓升高、坐立不安、失眠與焦慮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它的详细数据很少。作为麻黄碱的近亲，它可能造成心跳加快、血压升高、坐立不安、失眠与焦虑。

fact.en: It is ephedrine with a cinnamyl group on its nitrogen, the same carbon chain that gives cinnamon its flavour in the molecule cinnamaldehyde.
fact.zh: 它是在麻黃鹼的氮原子上接了肉桂基，這與肉桂醛中賦予肉桂風味的碳鏈相同。
fact.zhHans: 它是在麻黄碱的氮原子上接了肉桂基，这与肉桂醛中赋予肉桂风味的碳链相同。
